correctness.rationale: The outer mate is (1-z^m)/2 with a positive constant term. The plus-function relation gives tail sums on each residue class: the coefficient of f is t_j-t_(j+1) and that of f^+ is t_j+t_(j+1). Thus the canonical H(b_m) weights on the tail sequence are 2 at j=0 and 4 thereafter. In the Dirichlet quotient the monomial contribution is min(p,q) times a phase; the probability root average removes different residues and yields r+m min(i,j) for p=r+mi, q=r+mj. This gives the Dirichlet tridiagonal form with diagonal r+1,m+2,m+2,... and off-diagonal -1. The tail forms are equivalent on polynomial cores and completion identifies the same functions via their Hardy coefficients. The relative self-adjoint operator has a constant-coefficient tail with band [m/4,(m+4)/4] and only a finite-rank boundary change. Outside the band a decaying geometric tail satisfies 4 lambda=m+2-q-q^(-1), 2 lambda=r+1-q. Eliminating lambda gives q-q^(-1)=2r-m, with exactly one admissible root off the band when 2r differs from m (positive for a lower outlier, negative for an upper outlier). The boundary diagonal increases with r, so the global minimum is achieved in residue zero and the maximum in residue m-1. Taking the corresponding roots proves the displayed L_m and U_m and the geometric rational extremizers. For m=1,2 the top is the band edge, approached by long alternating bulk tails; its repeated characteristic root -1 allows no nonzero square-summable eigenvector. Finally L_m tends to 1/2 and U_m is asymptotic to m/2, yielding the stated distortion for the norms rather than their squares.

value.rationale: The canonical norms and probability Clark measure are natural, fixed choices, and qualitative equality leaves their comparison entirely uncalibrated as the number of atoms increases. The sharp distortion grows like sqrt(m), so this symmetric family already shows failure of uniform comparison. The exact constants and the transition from a nonattained band edge to a rational extremizer give information a user of the embedding cannot recover from generic equivalence or kernel testing.
residual_risks: The value claim is for equal atoms at all roots and the stated canonical norms; unequal masses and general finite Blaschke symbols are outside scope.
